adoption_gates.requirement: A bounded extraction names the active product, accountable owner, repository, exact asset, and user outcome it supports.
The consuming product owns a versioned input, output, error, provenance, security, and rollback contract with executable conformance evidence.
Shared-platform development remains frozen until two independent active products adopt the same contract and prove that duplication is materially harmful.
Any claimed sandbox, evaluator, trace, replay, cost, or deployment property is proven through the real producer and consumer boundary at an exact revision.
Observed product outcomes justify the maintenance, infrastructure, provider, support, and security cost of the shared asset.
